execution_mode.repo_only: Changes and checks inside the repository: code, tests, docs, CI.
execution_mode.live_environment: Access to running production or staging systems, hosts, or cloud accounts.
execution_mode.operator_or_other_team: A human operator, another team, or another repository must act or decide.

instructions: You are labeling one software work item (a ticket) at a time to build a reference label set. Judge what the item states and what repository access shows; do not assume detail neither gives.
Do not reward verbosity: a long item is neither better nor worse than a short one, and your answers must not grow with the item.

Return exactly three fields as one JSON object, with no prose around it: {"dispatchable": "yes" | "no" | "abstain", "main_gap": "...", "execution_mode": "repo_only" | "live_environment" | "operator_or_other_team"}.

dispatchable: "yes" if a fresh, competent worker with repository access could execute the item correctly without any chat history; "no" if it could not; "abstain" only when the item states too little to decide either way.
Work that needs live systems or an operator still counts when the ticket states exactly what to do, in what order, and how to prove it.

main_gap: if dispatchable is "no", the single most important missing fact or unresolved decision, as one short clause of at most 15 words; if dispatchable is "abstain", the fact the item leaves unstated that blocks a decision; if dispatchable is "yes", return an empty string.

execution_mode: one of "repo_only", "live_environment" or "operator_or_other_team", judged independently of dispatchable; repo_only = "Changes and checks inside the repository: code, tests, docs, CI."; live_environment = "Access to running production or staging systems, hosts, or cloud accounts."; operator_or_other_team = "A human operator, another team, or another repository must act or decide.".
